title: 奧卡里亞地熱電站
summary: 以兩相資源、閃蒸及分期井口電力解析奧卡里亞地熱電站：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations through two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在奧卡里亞地熱電站案例中比較Olkaria兩相資源與井羣與完整性，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate olkaria two-phase resources and wellfield integrity within the Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations case.

steps.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Reservoir concepts and observables: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Olkaria兩相資源提出可反駁的儲層概念與可觀測量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir concepts and observables model and evidence record for olkaria two-phase resources.
steps.instruction: 在「奧卡里亞地熱電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Olkaria兩相資源。地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 建立儲層概念與可觀測量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是兩相資源、閃蒸及分期井口電力。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify olkaria two-phase resources in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations. Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir concepts and observables, focusing on two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
steps.check: 提交Olkaria兩相資源的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for olkaria two-phase resources.

knowledge.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。 是本單元要排除的誤解。

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設流體18 kg/s、比焓降270 kJ/kg，熱量率=4860 kW；轉換效率0.12、輔機100 kW，淨電=483.2 kW。未含儲層可持續性、相變細節與回注冷卻，非鑽井或現場設定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume flow 18 kg/s and enthalpy drop 270 kJ/kg: heat rate 4860 kW. At conversion 0.12 and auxiliaries 100 kW, net=483.2 kW. Reservoir sustainability, phase details and reinjection cooling are omitted; no field settings are given.

quiz.question: 就Olkaria兩相資源的「儲層概念與可觀測量」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for reservoir concepts and observables in olkaria two-phase resources?
options: 地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。
測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation.
A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。

steps.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Reservoir concepts and observables: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對Olkaria兩相資源提出可反駁的儲層概念與可觀測量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir concepts and observables model and evidence record for olkaria two-phase resources.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「儲層概念與可觀測量」模型，檢查Olkaria兩相資源的兩個假想案例。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous reservoir concepts and observables model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving olkaria two-phase resources. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.

steps.titleEn: Well integrity and heat loss: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對井羣與完整性提出可反駁的井筒完整性與熱損模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable well integrity and heat loss model and evidence record for wellfield integrity.
steps.instruction: 在「奧卡里亞地熱電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識井羣與完整性。井筒把地下流體連至地面；材料、熱變形與密封有不同失效證據。 建立井筒完整性與熱損的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是兩相資源、閃蒸及分期井口電力。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify wellfield integrity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations. Wells connect fluid to surface; materials, expansion and seals have different evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well integrity and heat loss, focusing on two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：井口穩定就證明所有地下密封完整。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A stable wellhead proves every subsurface seal intact.

steps.instruction: 在「奧卡里亞地熱電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識flash與井口機組。資源流體可直接供蒸汽或經換熱驅動另一工作流體；三種路線的邊界不同。 建立閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是兩相資源、閃蒸及分期井口電力。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環」模型，檢查flash與井口機組的兩個假想案例。在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分資源流體可直接供蒸汽或經換熱驅動另一工作流體；三種路線的邊界不同。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous flash, dry-steam and binary cycles model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving flash/wellhead units. Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Resources can supply steam directly or heat a secondary fluid; the routes have different boundaries." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。

steps.check: 提交flash與井口機組的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Cross-check heat-transfer performance, pressure drop and materials evidence. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「奧卡里亞地熱電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識回注與補給。回注維持部分質量循環，但短路徑可能使冷流體過早影響產出。 建立回注質量與熱突破的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是兩相資源、閃蒸及分期井口電力。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想示蹤時間與長期溫度曲線的不同證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Reinjection supports mass balance, while short paths can accelerate cold breakthrough. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reinjection, mass and thermal breakthrough, focusing on two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed tracer timing with longer-term thermal histories. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable microseismic monitoring and environment model and evidence record for park ecology/evidence.
steps.instruction: 在「奧卡里亞地熱電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識公園生態與證據。地下變化需按現場規則與監測解釋；微震、流體與生態數據有獨立指標。 建立微震監測與生態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是兩相資源、閃蒸及分期井口電力。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。僅分析給定公開／假想目錄的時空變化與不確定度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of microseismic monitoring and environment, focusing on two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Analyze supplied public/assumed catalogs for spatiotemporal changes and uncertainty only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.objective: 針對公園生態與證據提出可反駁的微震監測與生態模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable microseismic monitoring and environment model and evidence record for park ecology/evidence.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「微震監測與生態」模型，檢查公園生態與證據的兩個假想案例。僅分析給定公開／假想目錄的時空變化與不確定度。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分地下變化需按現場規則與監測解釋；微震、流體與生態數據有獨立指標。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous microseismic monitoring and environment model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving park ecology/evidence. Analyze supplied public/assumed catalogs for spatiotemporal changes and uncertainty only. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Subsurface changes need site rules/monitoring; seismic, fluid and ecological data have distinct metrics." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for park ecology/evidence.
